sections.title: Employment Contract
sections.text:
Masamune and Yoshitsune of the Rhodes Island Recon are plotting a new survey route.

Take them out for a walk with you, and they'll be overjoyed.

sections.title: Token
sections.text: A mysterious ticket stamped with a paw print, and a wooden barrel lid covered in doodles. A token of friendship, meow!

sections.title: Profile
sections.text:
The Rhodes Island Recon is made up of the Palico Masamune and the Palamute Yoshitsune; the name comes from the unit they belonged to back home in Kamura Village—the “Buddy Recon.” Both had already received professional training in intelligence gathering and material collection, and they honed those skills over a long stretch in the Bubbly Realm, so they began playing an important part in assignments the moment they joined Rhodes Island. They want to find the road home, yet they are also quite taken with adventuring across the continent of Terra, and so they have adapted to life here rather well.
Lively and friendly, Masamune quickly became a star among the Operators—no small number of them have applied to go out on missions with him purely to get a look at the cute, talking “cloudbeast.” Yoshitsune, aloof by nature, has likewise hit it off with the many Operators who are keen on combat.

sections.title: Clinical Analysis
sections.text:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs in both Operators, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, these Operators are believed to be non-infected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Neither Masamune nor Yoshitsune shows any sign of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] Undisclosed
The Medical Department has agreed not to disclose the relevant data.

sections.title: Archive File 1
sections.text:
While talking with the members of Squad A6 about the concept of the “Hunter,” Masamune set aside his usual liveliness and turned somewhat solemn, and Yoshitsune, feigning sleep at his side, pricked up his ears as well.
In their homeland, a Hunter's work is to protect the ecosystem while hunting monsters, which makes every Hunter a pioneer venturing into the unknown. The “Blaze of Kamura,” for instance, is the great hero who resolved Kamura Village's crisis—the “Rampage.”
“Every great Hunter shares one trait, and that's—a challenging spirit that never gives up, meow!”
No matter how troublesome the foe, no matter how many times they fail, a true Hunter keeps mounting one challenge after another—until victory, or until they fall. In Masamune's telling, a “Hunter” is not merely a profession, but the symbol of a spirit.
“Sounds like the thing furthest from this squad of ours.” Spot couldn't help remarking.
“Yeah, I think so too. I'm nothing that impressive, I just do it because it's fun.” Catapult chimed in as well. A challenging spirit? She hardly thought her own reason for picking up a Charge Blade was anything so noble.
But Masamune shook his head.
“If this were before, I might have thought so too, meow. But it's different now—the people of the Bubbly Realm, the people of Rhodes Island, they just fight different opponents for different reasons than Hunters do, meow! Everyone here is full of that challenging spirit, meow!”
